name: China Great Wall Securities Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: China Great Wall Securities Co., Ltd. engages in the securities brokerage and investment consulting services. It offers securities trading and investment activities, underwriting & sponsorship, proprietary trading, asset management, margin trading, securities investment fund agency sales, intermediary introduction services for futures companies, and agency sales of financial products. The company was founded on November 24, 1995 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
